x:
Televators work in pairs. Place the first Televator and it will remain offline (gray) while unlinked. Then place a second Televator anywhere directly above or below it on the same X/Z coordinates.

Whenever a Televator is placed, it automatically searches for another unlinked Televator. It always searches upward first, then downward. When an unlinked Televator is found, the two pads link together and both become active (green). A Televator can only be linked to one other Televator at a time and they only teleport players. Breaking a Televator automatically unlinks its partner and turns it offline.

Step onto an active Televator to instantly teleport to its linked Televator. After teleporting, both Televators enter cooldown mode and cannot be used again until the cooldown expires. Upon arrival, you will face the direction of the destination Televator. The diamond-shaped lamp indicates its facing direction. Use a wrench to rotate a placed Televator and adjust the direction players will face after teleportation.
